Recommendations for mixed weddings
Hi, I’m a Mexican citizen on A5 visa and my fiancée is Israeli. We will get married in October in Israel with our Reform Rabbi, sadly, it won’t be recognized by MOI because it won’t be done by the rabanut. 

So we would like some recommendations of ways or places to get married near here, maybe Cyprus or Greece. And also to understand if it’s better to do it with an agency.  

Thanks a lot!
